line: - **sprint-or-modes** The PO picks a design sprint or the five modes; default to a design sprint only if a prototype must be tested with role cards.
note: The tail 'a chat's research can count as Empathize material' is in research-as-empathize (drafted under ideo-log#2, which carries the same sentence); 'then still run that stage' (do not skip Empathize) is in open-a-design.

lines: - **modes-are-not-the-sprint** Keep modes and sprint apart: an IDEO log runs no map, Lightning Demos or storyboard; a design sprint opens no IDEO log.
- **research-as-empathize** Chat or IDEO-log research can count as Empathize material, but a design sprint still starts on the PO's permission.
where_else: What the five modes and the design sprint's stages are (stages stand on modes, the book's steps, a PO decision between stages, role-card tests) is in plugins/ideo-scrum/skills/design-kernel/SKILL.md and plugins/ideo-scrum/skills/ideo-kernel/SKILL.md.
note: The annotation asked to keep 'IDEO log counts as Empathize material' and 'no map, Lightning Demos, storyboard'; both are kept. The old 'Do not mix them' lost its referent once the line stands alone, so the line now says what is kept apart.

lines: - **open-ideo-log** 1-2 methods in one session: note them in the log served (Increment notes, Notes); more: an IDEO log, five chapters, no PO gate.
- **read-mode-file** Read a mode's or method's file in the ideo-kernel before using it; a chapter holds what its mode produced.
note: The threshold (one or two methods, or one session) is the author's; the PO may set it again.

lines: - **ideo-log-home** An IDEO log, its prototypes and working material live in scrum/ideo-<suffix>/; no commitment. Read details/ideo-ending.md first.
- **ideo-log-ends** Conclusions flow back to the log that asked and the PO decides; archive at the next Review. Read details/ideo-ending.md first.
where_else: The Now and Waiting for PO header format is in plugins/ideo-scrum/template/ideo-backlog-template.md (lines 4-5); the archiving of an IDEO log is also in sprint-log#17 (the Review rule).
note: Long file keeps the prototype handoff word for word: a prototype whose conclusions will be built goes to the Sprint that builds them, as that Sprint's specification; if that Sprint is not open yet it stays in the IDEO folder until the handoff; any other standalone IDEO prototype is deleted when the work is done. ideo-kernel's SKILL.md points back to this rule.
